events.verdict: Collins (UTA) brings his left arm backward as he rolls toward the post and the contact with Vincent's (LAL) head is marginal.
Vincent (LAL) and Collins (UTA) briefly engage, but neither player is in position to reach the pass.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Sexton (UTA) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Christie (LAL) and George (UTA) engage off ball and although Christie extends his arms slightly to release, the contact does not cause George to become dislodged from his position.
Davis (LAL) is firming up over his right foot in George's (UTA) path and does not deliver illegal contact during the pick.
Markkanen (UTA) is off-balance when he establishes himself in a screening position in Vincent's (LAL) path and although he leans forwards, he does not deliver contact.
Davis (LAL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Hachimura (LAL) moves into George's (UTA) path and initiates body contact that affects George's driving shot attempt.
James (LAL) mishandles his dribble, but not as a result of any marginal contact from George (UTA).
Collins (UTA) contests the driving shot attempt and marginal contact occurs with James' (LAL) left arm after the release.
Sexton (UTA) releases the throw-in within five seconds.
Davis (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position during George's (UTA) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Markkanen (UTA) legally contests James' (LAL) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
James (LAL) briefly places a hand on Sexton (UTA) as he mishandles the throw-in and the contact is marginal.
James (LAL) avoids making contact with Sexton (UTA) during Sexton's upward shooting motion prior to the game clock expiring.
